%d contenuti sono fatti con i suoi blocc: %d contents are made with its blocks and now show nothing.

Fondamenta è ferma: il plugin che disegn: Fondamenta is stopped: the plugin that draws the pages of this site (folder “xb”) is not installed.

The content of the post shown.
Dentro un loop: i blocchi da mostrare qu: Inside a loop: the blocks to show when the loop has no items.
Il contenuto del post mostrato, senza in: The content of the post shown, with no wrapper.
Un elemento HTML con il suo tag e i suoi: An HTML element with its tag and attributes: it holds other blocks, a text or nothing.

Per convertire queste pagine nei blocchi: Converting these pages into Fondamenta's blocks needs the plugin active: activate it again.
Un testo con valori del contenuto mostra: A text with values of the content shown, with no element around it (between two elements on the same line).
Ripete i suoi blocchi per ogni contenuto: Repeats its blocks for each content of a query, of the page's query or of a filtered list, for each term of the content, for each value or row of a field, for each page of an archive, for each option of a filter.
